dedupe_keys.name: validated european food loss and waste prevention inventory n 1 324

description: University of Deusto researchers publish 1,324 European food-loss and waste-prevention entries with a separate 199-entry audit sample. The June 2026 CSV downloads are free under CC BY 4.0. Documentation identifies action descriptions, source, food-chain stage, action type, root cause, inference confidence and validation status. The inventory combines a public tracker with an expert benchmark and can define intervention options or policy categories for food-system simulations. Some low-confidence entries are retained for traceability even though they may be news or project announcements. Therefore the title does not establish that every row is an implemented or effective intervention. Observation periods, country completeness and outcome effect sizes remain unknown. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this harmonised inventory. Documentation was read, but the CSV rows and classification accuracy were not inspected.
